oneLine: KNR Constructions sells stake in KNR Guruvayur Infra for Rs 486 crore to Indus Infra Trust.

sources.title: KNR Constructions sells stake in KNR Guruvayur Infra to Indus Infra Trust for Rs 486 crore

synopsis: KNR Constructions Limited completed the transfer of its entire equity share capital in its subsidiary, KNR Guruvayur Infra Private Limited, to Indus Infra Trust for a total consideration of 485.86 crore rupees. The transaction was finalized on September 17, 2026, following Share Purchase Agreements executed on December 24, 2025. KNR Constructions had originally invested 193.32 crore rupees in the subsidiary through equity and subordinated debt. Indus Infra Trust is not part of KNR Constructions' promoter or group companies, confirming the deal is not a related party transaction. The subsidiary previously reported a turnover of 237.21 crore rupees and a net worth of 394.38 crore rupees as of March 31, 2026.
